summary: Qzone RPC is reachable and authorized from this client. The 2026-11-18 'not authorized' finding was an artefact of a probe that omitted the x-oidb header: the gateway is addressed by that header, so without it there was no command to authorize.

superseded_finding.conclusion: every RPC -> retcode 4001 'not authorized', including with no cookie; endpoint refuses before checking credentials
superseded_finding.why_it_was_wrong: The empty-cookie control was valid but measured the wrong thing. The probe sent Content-Type / Origin / Referer / User-Agent / Cookie and no x-oidb, so the gateway had no uint32_command to route. 4001 answered 'which command is this?', not 'are you allowed?'.

with_x_oidb.note: EntranceCtrl/BatchEntranceWhitelist answered with real entrance data for the account

GetFriendFeeds_0x97e5_0.note: returned a feed list with cell_* structures (cell_feed_deco, cell_media, cell_foward_info ...)

GetShuoshuoList_0x9a97_1.note: returned this account's own posts plus an attach_info pagination cursor

what_works: p_skey for qzone.qq.com via TipOffService.getPskey(domains, true)
POST https://h5.qzone.qq.com/http2rpc/gotrpc/v1/{service}/{method}?g_tk=... with headers Cookie, x-oidb, x-web-qua
open_questions: p_skey is unavailable for h5.qzone.qq.com and user.qzone.qq.com (1003). Everything measured works with the qzone.qq.com key, but a call that requires the h5 key would fail.
Request bodies are guesses: GetFriendFeeds answered retcode 0 even with {}, so pagination/filter parameters are unverified.
Responses are raw cell_* structures; no normalisation exists yet.
The 14 'public qzone' (空友爱看) routes and the write routes (PublishFeed 0x9775, likes, comments) are untested.
Old CGI routes (taotao/profile via /proxy/domain/) are untested — they take no x-oidb, so the earlier 4001 may genuinely apply to them.

blocked_in_product_code.behaviour: answers UNSUPPORTED with 'Qzone RPC refuses every request with retcode 4001 before checking credentials'
blocked_in_product_code.status: now known to be false; must be removed before QZone can be implemented

how_to_recheck: uv run python tools/probe_qzone_auth.py — it queues a probe through the live pipe session and prints all four cases plus two business calls.
